title: 岩石邊坡錨固與監測
summary: 本課聚焦從節理幾何、錨固荷載與量測基準判讀岩坡穩定。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。
summaryEn: This course focuses on interpret rock slope stability through discontinuity geometry, anchor loads and measurement datums. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「節理出露幾何」與「孔壓扣除法向力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Discontinuity daylighting geometry" and "Pore pressure and normal force": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 節理出露幾何：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Discontinuity daylighting geometry: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「節理出露幾何」如何影響岩石邊坡錨固與監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Discontinuity daylighting geometry” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-slope anchoring and monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 平面滑動先受節理方向及坡面幾何控制，節理比坡面緩只是必要幾何條件之一。必須另外確認傾向相近、連續長度、側向釋放面與摩擦，不能把角度差當安全儲備。假設坡面傾角65°、節理傾角40°且傾向一致，幾何角差65−40=25°；此角差不是安全係數，也未檢查楔形或傾倒機制。僅憑一張正面照片量角，會漏掉向側方滑動的楔體；錨索方向若建立在錯誤滑面上，外觀整齊仍不能形成有效的跨面約束。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「節理出露幾何」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Planar sliding first depends on discontinuity orientation and slope geometry. A joint flatter than the face meets only one geometric condition. Similar dip direction, persistence, lateral release surfaces and friction also matter; the angular difference is not a stability reserve. Assume a65° face and40° joint with matching dip direction. The angular difference is65−40=25°. It is not a safety factor and does not test wedge sliding or toppling. Angles from a single frontal photograph can miss a laterally sliding wedge. Anchors designed around the wrong plane may look orderly while failing to restrain movement across the actual discontinuity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Discontinuity daylighting geometry” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設坡面傾角65°、節理傾角40°且傾向一致，幾何角差65−40=25°；此角差不是安全係數，也未檢查楔形或傾倒機制。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Assume a65° face and40° joint with matching dip direction.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要節理出露幾何符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for discontinuity daylighting geometry removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「節理出露幾何」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Discontinuity daylighting geometry”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 節理出露幾何
knowledge.text: 平面滑動先受節理方向及坡面幾何控制，節理比坡面緩只是必要幾何條件之一。必須另外確認傾向相近、連續長度、側向釋放面與摩擦，不能把角度差當安全儲備。
knowledge.textEn: Planar sliding first depends on discontinuity orientation and slope geometry. A joint flatter than the face meets only one geometric condition.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要節理出露幾何符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for discontinuity daylighting geometry removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「節理出露幾何」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Discontinuity daylighting geometry" is correct?
options: 只要節理出露幾何符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
平面滑動先受節理方向及坡面幾何控制，節理比坡面緩只是必要幾何條件之一。
只要孔壓扣除法向力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for discontinuity daylighting geometry removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Planar sliding first depends on discontinuity orientation and slope geometry.
A nominal result for pore pressure and normal force removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 平面滑動先受節理方向及坡面幾何控制，節理比坡面緩只是必要幾何條件之一。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Planar sliding first depends on discontinuity orientation and slope geometry. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 節理出露幾何：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Discontinuity daylighting geometry: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「節理出露幾何」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Discontinuity daylighting geometry” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設坡面傾角65°、節理傾角40°且傾向一致，幾何角差65−40=25°；此角差不是安全係數，也未檢查楔形或傾倒機制。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Assume a65° face and40° joint with matching dip direction. The angular difference is65−40=25°. It is not a safety factor and does not test wedge sliding or toppling. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用地質羅盤或定向影像分組記錄節理傾向、傾角及延續性，對照實際坡面建立立體投影。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Group dip directions, dips and persistence using a geological compass or oriented images, then compare them with the actual face on a stereonet.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設坡面傾角65°、節理傾角40°且傾向一致，幾何角差65−40=25°；此角差不是安全係數，也未檢查楔形或傾倒機制。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Assume a65° face and40° joint with matching dip direction. The angular difference is65−40=25°. It is not a safety factor and does not test wedge sliding or toppling.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「節理出露幾何」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Discontinuity daylighting geometry", which statement holds?
options: 只要錨索方向分量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要落石位能尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設坡面傾角65°、節理傾角40°且傾向一致，幾何角差65−40=25°；此角差不是安全係數，也未檢查楔形或傾倒機制。
optionsEn: A nominal result for anchor force projection removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for rockfall energy scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Assume a65° face and40° joint with matching dip direction.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設坡面傾角65°、節理傾角40°且傾向一致，幾何角差65−40=25°；此角差不是安全係數，也未檢查楔形或傾倒機制。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Assume a65° face and40° joint with matching dip direction. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 節理出露幾何：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Discontinuity daylighting geometry: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「節理出露幾何」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Discontinuity daylighting geometry” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用地質羅盤或定向影像分組記錄節理傾向、傾角及延續性，對照實際坡面建立立體投影。將不可見延伸列成不確定區，由岩土工程師確認控制滑動模式。同時排除以下干擾原因：僅憑一張正面照片量角，會漏掉向側方滑動的楔體；錨索方向若建立在錯誤滑面上，外觀整齊仍不能形成有效的跨面約束。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Group dip directions, dips and persistence using a geological compass or oriented images, then compare them with the actual face on a stereonet. Mark hidden extensions as uncertain and have the geotechnical engineer identify controlling mechanisms. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Angles from a single frontal photograph can miss a laterally sliding wedge. Anchors designed around the wrong plane may look orderly while failing to restrain movement across the actual discontinuity. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接節理出露幾何時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。用地質羅盤或定向影像分組記錄節理傾向、傾角及延續性，對照實際坡面建立立體投影。將不可見延伸列成不確定區，由岩土工程師確認控制滑動模式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over discontinuity daylighting geometry, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Group dip directions, dips and persistence using a geological compass or oriented images, then compare them with the actual face on a stereonet. Mark hidden extensions as uncertain and have the geotechnical engineer identify controlling mechanisms.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：僅憑一張正面照片量角，會漏掉向側方滑動的楔體；錨索方向若建立在錯誤滑面上，外觀整齊仍不能形成有效的跨面約束。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Angles from a single frontal photograph can miss a laterally sliding wedge. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用地質羅盤或定向影像分組記錄節理傾向、傾角及延續性，對照實際坡面建立立體投影。將不可見延伸列成不確定區，由岩土工程師確認控制滑動模式。同時排除以下干擾原因：僅憑一張正面照片量角，會漏掉向側方滑動的楔體；錨索方向若建立在錯誤滑面上，外觀整齊仍不能形成有效的跨面約束。
knowledge.textEn: Group dip directions, dips and persistence using a geological compass or oriented images, then compare them with the actual face on a stereonet. Mark hidden extensions as uncertain and have the geotechnical engineer identify controlling mechanisms. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Angles from a single frontal photograph can miss a laterally sliding wedge. Anchors designed around the wrong plane may look orderly while failing to restrain movement across the actual discontinuity.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接節理出露幾何時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。用地質羅盤或定向影像分組記錄節理傾向、傾角及延續性，對照實際坡面建立立體投影。將不可見延伸列成不確定區，由岩土工程師確認控制滑動模式。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over discontinuity daylighting geometry, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Group dip directions, dips and persistence using a geological compass or oriented images, then compare them with the actual face on a stereonet. Mark hidden extensions as uncertain and have the geotechnical engineer identify controlling mechanisms.

quiz.question: 要驗證「節理出露幾何」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Discontinuity daylighting geometry"?
options: 用地質羅盤或定向影像分組記錄節理傾向、傾角及延續性，對照實際坡面建立立體投影。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要位移量測投影符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Group dip directions, dips and persistence using a geological compass or oriented images, then compare them with the actual face on a stereonet.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A nominal result for displacement measurement projection removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 用地質羅盤或定向影像分組記錄節理傾向、傾角及延續性，對照實際坡面建立立體投影。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Group dip directions, dips and persistence using a geological compass or oriented images, then compare them with the actual face on a stereonet. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 節理出露幾何：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Discontinuity daylighting geometry: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「節理出露幾何」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Discontinuity daylighting geometry” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 僅憑一張正面照片量角，會漏掉向側方滑動的楔體；錨索方向若建立在錯誤滑面上，外觀整齊仍不能形成有效的跨面約束。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Angles from a single frontal photograph can miss a laterally sliding wedge. Anchors designed around the wrong plane may look orderly while failing to restrain movement across the actual discontinuity. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：僅憑一張正面照片量角，會漏掉向側方滑動的楔體；錨索方向若建立在錯誤滑面上，外觀整齊仍不能形成有效的跨面約束。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Anchors designed around the wrong plane may look orderly while failing to restrain movement across the actual discontinuity.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要節理出露幾何符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for discontinuity daylighting geometry removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 僅憑一張正面照片量角，會漏掉向側方滑動的楔體；錨索方向若建立在錯誤滑面上，外觀整齊仍不能形成有效的跨面約束。
knowledge.textEn: Angles from a single frontal photograph can miss a laterally sliding wedge. Anchors designed around the wrong plane may look orderly while failing to restrain movement across the actual discontinuity.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「節理出露幾何」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Discontinuity daylighting geometry" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
僅憑一張正面照片量角，會漏掉向側方滑動的楔體；錨索方向若建立在錯誤滑面上，外觀整齊仍不能形成有效的跨面約束。
只要孔壓扣除法向力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Angles from a single frontal photograph can miss a laterally sliding wedge.
A nominal result for pore pressure and normal force removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 僅憑一張正面照片量角，會漏掉向側方滑動的楔體；錨索方向若建立在錯誤滑面上，外觀整齊仍不能形成有效的跨面約束。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Angles from a single frontal photograph can miss a laterally sliding wedge. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 孔壓扣除法向力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pore pressure and normal force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「孔壓扣除法向力」如何影響岩石邊坡錨固與監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pore pressure and normal force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-slope anchoring and monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 岩塊重量分解到滑面後，水壓合力會減少有效接觸力。此處假設單一平面及合力已知，張裂縫水推力與地震慣性需另加，不能混入同一孔壓數字。W=1000kN、滑面角30°、法向水壓合力U=200kN時，N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN；正值只表示此模型仍保持壓縮接觸。把坡腳排水孔讀值當作全滑面水壓可高估有效正向力；降雨後上部裂隙仍蓄水時，摩擦抗力可能下降而監測畫面顯示正常。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「孔壓扣除法向力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Resolve block weight normal to the sliding plane before subtracting water thrust. The example assumes one plane and a known resultant; crack-water thrust and seismic inertia require separate terms rather than being hidden inside one pore-pressure value. For W=1000kN, plane angle30° and normal water thrust U=200kN, N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN. A positive result only indicates compressive contact in this model. Using a toe-drain reading for the whole plane can overestimate effective normal force; upper fractures may retain storm water and reduce friction while the monitoring display appears normal. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pore pressure and normal force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：W=1000kN、滑面角30°、法向水壓合力U=200kN時，N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN；正值只表示此模型仍保持壓縮接觸。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For W=1000kN, plane angle30° and normal water thrust U=200kN, N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要孔壓扣除法向力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for pore pressure and normal force removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「孔壓扣除法向力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pore pressure and normal force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 岩塊重量分解到滑面後，水壓合力會減少有效接觸力。此處假設單一平面及合力已知，張裂縫水推力與地震慣性需另加，不能混入同一孔壓數字。
knowledge.textEn: Resolve block weight normal to the sliding plane before subtracting water thrust. The example assumes one plane and a known resultant; crack-water thrust and seismic inertia require separate terms rather than being hidden inside one pore-pressure value.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要孔壓扣除法向力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for pore pressure and normal force removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「孔壓扣除法向力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pore pressure and normal force" is correct?

只要節理摩擦抗力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
岩塊重量分解到滑面後，水壓合力會減少有效接觸力。
optionsEn: A nominal result for pore pressure and normal force removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for discontinuity friction resistance removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Resolve block weight normal to the sliding plane before subtracting water thrust.
quiz.explanation: 岩塊重量分解到滑面後，水壓合力會減少有效接觸力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 孔壓扣除法向力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pore pressure and normal force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「孔壓扣除法向力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pore pressure and normal force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：W=1000kN、滑面角30°、法向水壓合力U=200kN時，N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN；正值只表示此模型仍保持壓縮接觸。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For W=1000kN, plane angle30° and normal water thrust U=200kN, N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN. A positive result only indicates compressive contact in this model. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將孔壓測點與滑面交會高程一起標示，沿面積分取得水壓合力，再與自由體圖逐項核對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot piezometer positions with their intersections on the plane, integrate pressure over area and reconcile the resultant with the free-body diagram.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：W=1000kN、滑面角30°、法向水壓合力U=200kN時，N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN；正值只表示此模型仍保持壓縮接觸。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For W=1000kN, plane angle30° and normal water thrust U=200kN, N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN. A positive result only indicates compressive contact in this model.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「孔壓扣除法向力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pore pressure and normal force", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非現場設定值：W=1000kN、滑面角30°、法向水壓合力U=200kN時，N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN；正值只表示此模型仍保持壓縮接觸。
只要穩定區錨固長度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要排水恢復摩擦符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For W=1000kN, plane angle30° and normal water thrust U=200kN, N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN.
A nominal result for bond beyond the moving zone removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for drainage and friction recovery removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：W=1000kN、滑面角30°、法向水壓合力U=200kN時，N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN；正值只表示此模型仍保持壓縮接觸。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For W=1000kN, plane angle30° and normal water thrust U=200kN, N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 孔壓扣除法向力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pore pressure and normal force: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「孔壓扣除法向力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pore pressure and normal force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將孔壓測點與滑面交會高程一起標示，沿面積分取得水壓合力，再與自由體圖逐項核對。若量測僅在單一裂隙，應保留其他裂隙水力連通的不確定性。同時排除以下干擾原因：把坡腳排水孔讀值當作全滑面水壓可高估有效正向力；降雨後上部裂隙仍蓄水時，摩擦抗力可能下降而監測畫面顯示正常。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot piezometer positions with their intersections on the plane, integrate pressure over area and reconcile the resultant with the free-body diagram. A reading in one fracture leaves hydraulic connectivity to other fractures uncertain. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Using a toe-drain reading for the whole plane can overestimate effective normal force; upper fractures may retain storm water and reduce friction while the monitoring display appears normal. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接孔壓扣除法向力時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。將孔壓測點與滑面交會高程一起標示，沿面積分取得水壓合力，再與自由體圖逐項核對。若量測僅在單一裂隙，應保留其他裂隙水力連通的不確定性。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over pore pressure and normal force, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Plot piezometer positions with their intersections on the plane, integrate pressure over area and reconcile the resultant with the free-body diagram. A reading in one fracture leaves hydraulic connectivity to other fractures uncertain.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把坡腳排水孔讀值當作全滑面水壓可高估有效正向力；降雨後上部裂隙仍蓄水時，摩擦抗力可能下降而監測畫面顯示正常。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using a toe-drain reading for the whole plane can overestimate effective normal force; upper fractures may retain storm water and reduce friction while the monitoring display appears normal. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將孔壓測點與滑面交會高程一起標示，沿面積分取得水壓合力，再與自由體圖逐項核對。若量測僅在單一裂隙，應保留其他裂隙水力連通的不確定性。同時排除以下干擾原因：把坡腳排水孔讀值當作全滑面水壓可高估有效正向力；降雨後上部裂隙仍蓄水時，摩擦抗力可能下降而監測畫面顯示正常。
knowledge.textEn: Plot piezometer positions with their intersections on the plane, integrate pressure over area and reconcile the resultant with the free-body diagram. A reading in one fracture leaves hydraulic connectivity to other fractures uncertain. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Using a toe-drain reading for the whole plane can overestimate effective normal force; upper fractures may retain storm water and reduce friction while the monitoring display appears normal.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接孔壓扣除法向力時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。將孔壓測點與滑面交會高程一起標示，沿面積分取得水壓合力，再與自由體圖逐項核對。若量測僅在單一裂隙，應保留其他裂隙水力連通的不確定性。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over pore pressure and normal force, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Plot piezometer positions with their intersections on the plane, integrate pressure over area and reconcile the resultant with the free-body diagram. quiz.question: 要驗證「孔壓扣除法向力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pore pressure and normal force"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將孔壓測點與滑面交會高程一起標示，沿面積分取得水壓合力，再與自由體圖逐項核對。
只要位移速率與時窗符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Plot piezometer positions with their intersections on the plane, integrate pressure over area and reconcile the resultant with the free-body diagram.
A nominal result for movement rate and time window removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

steps.title: 孔壓扣除法向力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pore pressure and normal force: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「孔壓扣除法向力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pore pressure and normal force” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把坡腳排水孔讀值當作全滑面水壓可高估有效正向力；降雨後上部裂隙仍蓄水時，摩擦抗力可能下降而監測畫面顯示正常。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using a toe-drain reading for the whole plane can overestimate effective normal force; upper fractures may retain storm water and reduce friction while the monitoring display appears normal. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把坡腳排水孔讀值當作全滑面水壓可高估有效正向力；降雨後上部裂隙仍蓄水時，摩擦抗力可能下降而監測畫面顯示正常。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Using a toe-drain reading for the whole plane can overestimate effective normal force; upper fractures may retain storm water and reduce friction while the monitoring display appears normal.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要孔壓扣除法向力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for pore pressure and normal force removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把坡腳排水孔讀值當作全滑面水壓可高估有效正向力；降雨後上部裂隙仍蓄水時，摩擦抗力可能下降而監測畫面顯示正常。
knowledge.textEn: Using a toe-drain reading for the whole plane can overestimate effective normal force; upper fractures may retain storm water and reduce friction while the monitoring display appears normal.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「孔壓扣除法向力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pore pressure and normal force" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要節理摩擦抗力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
把坡腳排水孔讀值當作全滑面水壓可高估有效正向力；降雨後上部裂隙仍蓄水時，摩擦抗力可能下降而監測畫面顯示正常。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A nominal result for discontinuity friction resistance removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Using a toe-drain reading for the whole plane can overestimate effective normal force.
quiz.explanation: 把坡腳排水孔讀值當作全滑面水壓可高估有效正向力；降雨後上部裂隙仍蓄水時，摩擦抗力可能下降而監測畫面顯示正常。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using a toe-drain reading for the whole plane can overestimate effective normal force; upper fractures may retain storm water and reduce friction while the monitoring display appears normal. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
